Definition: to crack off, i.e. (figuratively) burst out in rage
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be displeased, be angry, fret oneself, be wroth; 1a) (Qal) to be wroth, to be full of wrath, to be furious; 1b) (Hiphil) to provoke to wrath or anger; 1c) (Hithpael) to put oneself in a rage, anger oneself
